entities.name: Invasion of Tolaria
entities.description: A decade-long Phyrexian assault on Tolaria ending in a climactic battle in 3357 AR.

entities.name: Tolaria
entities.description: Island on Dominaria and site of a school, attacked by Phyrexians.

entities.name: Barrin
entities.description: Defender of Tolaria who summoned artifact creatures.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Planeswalker who teleported in from Yavimaya and led the defense.

entities.name: Multani
entities.description: Forest spirit whose strength enabled Urza to planeswalk.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: Ally gathered by Urza on Shiv.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Ally gathered by Urza on Shiv.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Ally gathered by Urza on Shiv.

entities.name: Rhammidarigaaz
entities.description: Dragon ally of Urza, son of Gherridarigaaz.

entities.name: Gherridarigaaz
entities.description: Dragon on Shiv convinced to fight.

events.summary: Barrin witnesses a massive Phyrexian assault on Tolaria and summons artifact creatures.
events.quote: Barrin witnessed a massive Phyrexian assault, featuring grotesque monsters and warped humanoids.

events.summary: Urza teleports in from Yavimaya with Multani's spirit and seals wells and repairs walls.
events.quote: Urza teleported in from his imprisonment in Yavimaya carrying the spirit of Multani with him.
Teleporting to Shiv , Urza gathered reinforcements

events.summary: Urza convinces Gherridarigaaz to fight by promising to reunite her with her son.
events.quote: convinced her to fight by promising to reunite her with her son, Rhammidarigaaz.

events.summary: Urza destroys a dam to flood the gorge and infiltrates the time rent.
events.quote: He destroyed the dam, unleashing a massive flood that swept him into the gorge.

events.summary: Urza ignites the vats of embryonic Phyrexians with lightning.
events.quote: Urza unleashed devastating lightning to ignite the vats, obliterating the creatures and the facilities.

events.summary: A reprogrammed falcon engine ambushes and savages Urza; K'rrik appears.
events.quote: The machine savaged his body, preventing him from regenerating or planeswalking to safety.

events.summary: Empowered by Multani, Urza planeswalks into K'rrik's body, destroying him.
events.quote: Urza planeswalked directly into K'rrik's body, destroying him from within in an explosive burst of flesh and oil.

events.summary: Urza cleanses the remaining chambers, allying with Multani.
events.quote: solidifying an alliance with the forest spirit.
